{{Top|leg}}
'''Feeding spikes''' were part of the [[Rellarin]] anatomy. The feeding spikes were in place of where [[Mouth/Legends|mouths]] were on most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Each Rellarin had a small cluster of feeding spikes that they used to draw in nourishment.
